prompt: Which player scored 20 goals in the English Premier League in the 2006-2007 season and won 'Chelsea Players Player of the Year' award in 2007?
answer: Didier Drogba scored 20 Premier League goals for Chelsea in the 2006–07 season and won the club’s Players’ Player of the Season award in 2007.
